_readme: Generic chunking config. To point this at new documents: add a rule keyed by doc_type (matched from front-matter 'doc_type', falling back to 'default'). No code changes needed for new document types that fit 'section' or 'fixed' strategies.

embedding._backend_options: tfidf (offline, default, no API key) | anthropic (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + anthropic package -- Anthropic does not offer an embeddings endpoint, so this project does not wire an 'anthropic' embedding path; left as a documented non-option) | openai (requires OPENAI_API_KEY + openai package)
